typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ReportName as string ('pfoxd105d vSphere World'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Name as string,
		{Interval Breakdown} as string,
		{Creation Date} as string,
		{Powered On} as string,
		Cluster as string,
		Host as string,
		{CPU Provisioned} as string,
		{CPU Utilization - P99} as string,
		{CPU Utilization - P95} as string,
		{CPU Utilization - P75} as string,
		{CPU Utilization - P50} as string,
		{CPU Utilization - MAX} as string,
		{CPU Utilization - AVG} as string,
		{CPU Provisioned MHZ} as string,
		{CPU Demand %} as string,
		{CPU Contention %} as string,
		{CPU Ready %} as string,
		{CPU Co-Stop %} as string,
		{RAM Provisioned} as string,
		{RAM Utilization - P99} as string,
		{RAM Utilization - P95} as string,
		{RAM Utilization - P75} as string,
		{RAM Utilization - P50} as string,
		{RAM Utilization - MAX} as string,
		{RAM Utilization - AVG} as string,
		{RAM Balloon} as string,
		{Memory Contention %} as string,
		{Memory Consumed (GB)} as string,
		{Host Demand (GB)} as string,
		{Guest Demand (GB)} as string,
		{Disk Space} as string,
		{Disk Space Used} as string,
		{File System Capacity} as string,
		{File System Utilization} as string,
		{VM Disk Read Latency (ms)} as string,
		{VM Disk Write Latency (ms)} as string,
		{vROps CPU Recommended Size (MHz)} as string,
		{vROps RAM Recommended Size (GB)} as string,
		UUID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GuestUtilization
GuestUtilization derive(report_name = toString($ReportName),
		importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Guest_Demand__GB_ as string,
		CPU_Demand__ as string,
		VM_Disk_Write_Latency__ms_ as string,
		CPU_Ready__ as string,
		Host_Demand__GB_ as string,
		VM_Disk_Read_Latency__ms_ as string,
		{CPU_Co-Stop__} as string,
		Disk_Space_Used as string,
		CPU_Provisioned_MHZ as string,
		uuid as string,
		Name as string,
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P50} as string,
		Memory_Consumed__GB_ as string,
		RAM_Balloon as string,
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P95} as string,
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P75} as string,
		CPU_Contention__ as string,
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P99} as string,
		{RAM_Utilization_-_AVG} as string,
		File_System_Utilization as string,
		RAM_Provisioned as string,
		{CPU_Utilization_-_MAX} as string,
		Memory_Contention__ as string,
		Interval_Breakdown as string,
		Cluster as string,
		vROps_RAM_Recommended_Size__GB_ as string,
		Host as string,
		CPU_Provisioned as string,
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P75} as string,
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P99} as string,
		Disk_Space as string,
		{CPU_Utilization_-_AVG} as string,
		{RAM_Utilization_-_MAX} as string,
		Creation_Date as string,
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P50} as string,
		report_name as string,
		Powered_On as string,
		File_System_Capacity as string,
		vROps_CPU_Recommended_Size__MHz_ as string,
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P95} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Guest_Demand__GB_ = {Guest Demand (GB)},
		CPU_Demand__ = {CPU Demand %},
		VM_Disk_Write_Latency__ms_ = {VM Disk Write Latency (ms)},
		CPU_Ready__ = {CPU Ready %},
		Host_Demand__GB_ = {Host Demand (GB)},
		VM_Disk_Read_Latency__ms_ = {VM Disk Read Latency (ms)},
		{CPU_Co-Stop__} = {CPU Co-Stop %},
		Disk_Space_Used = {Disk Space Used},
		CPU_Provisioned_MHZ = {CPU Provisioned MHZ},
		uuid = UUID,
		Name,
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P50} = {RAM Utilization - P50},
		Memory_Consumed__GB_ = {Memory Consumed (GB)},
		RAM_Balloon = {RAM Balloon},
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P95} = {RAM Utilization - P95},
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P75} = {RAM Utilization - P75},
		CPU_Contention__ = {CPU Contention %},
		{RAM_Utilization_-_P99} = {RAM Utilization - P99},
		{RAM_Utilization_-_AVG} = {RAM Utilization - AVG},
		File_System_Utilization = {File System Utilization},
		RAM_Provisioned = {RAM Provisioned},
		{CPU_Utilization_-_MAX} = {CPU Utilization - MAX},
		Memory_Contention__ = {Memory Contention %},
		Interval_Breakdown = {Interval Breakdown},
		Cluster,
		vROps_RAM_Recommended_Size__GB_ = {vROps RAM Recommended Size (GB)},
		Host,
		CPU_Provisioned = {CPU Provisioned},
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P75} = {CPU Utilization - P75},
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P99} = {CPU Utilization - P99},
		Disk_Space = {Disk Space},
		{CPU_Utilization_-_AVG} = {CPU Utilization - AVG},
		{RAM_Utilization_-_MAX} = {RAM Utilization - MAX},
		Creation_Date = {Creation Date},
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P50} = {CPU Utilization - P50},
		report_name,
		Powered_On = {Powered On},
		File_System_Capacity = {File System Capacity},
		vROps_CPU_Recommended_Size__MHz_ = {vROps CPU Recommended Size (MHz)},
		{CPU_Utilization_-_P95} = {CPU Utilization - P95}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
